en.html:
I would stay with the warrior's orthodox high guard.
From this stance came the greatest striking power. That was why it was orthodox. The standard had some reason behind it.

The enemy produced one strange trick, and I should abandon the proper method out of fear?
Finish the fight with this stroke. Then there would be no further tricks to worry about.

Aim for a gap in the plating. Drive the sword in!

に正調、常道なのだ。

　敵の奇手を恐れて、常道を曲げるべきではない。
　この一撃で勝負を決すれば済む話だ。

　甲鉄の隙間を狙い、一刀を叩き込む！
